note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors; nominations were received on 20 April 1927 and Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 1 June 1927. Two candidates were nominated for each of Fallagh, Fintona and Seskinore (Ulster Herald, 23 April 1927, p. 5); by 30 April the Fallagh and Fintona oppositions had been withdrawn, leaving Seskinore the only contest (Ulster Herald, 30 April 1927, p. 5: 'Thirteen Nationalists have therefore been returned unopposed to the Rural Council, as compared with twenty Unionists'). In Fallagh Mr. Thomas Cunningham (N.) 'has withdrawn his opposition', and Mr. Patrick Clarke, Gortin, 'has been returned unopposed' (Ulster Herald, 30 April 1927, p. 5). Labels as printed in the nomination list. Returned unopposed.
